claims.text: The authors propose two new unsupervised representation-learning objectives: FastSent and Sequential Denoising Autoencoders (SDAEs).
FastSent is a sentence-level log-linear bag-of-words model designed for efficient representation learning.
Sequential Denoising Autoencoders (SDAEs) are introduced to address limitations of existing models like SkipThought, particularly in variable-length sentence contexts.
